description: Election Commission - Mr. H. I. R. Hathurusinghe the Assistant Commissioner of Election appointed as the Returning Officer of all Local Authorities of the Administrative District of Badulla
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically concerns electoral administration, detailing the appointment and substitution of a Returning Officer for Local Authorities elections in the Badulla administrative district. It is issued by the Election Commission under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it clearly related to electoral processes.
